Definition: ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits)
BiblicalUsage: ʻEser is ten — the number of the commandments God spoke from Sinai, and the number of the plagues that fell on Egypt. Israel counted ten as the shape of the covenant, and the ten words as the whole law in miniature.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʻeser matters because the ten words are the covenant in miniature: ten commands that hold the whole relationship between God and His people. I hold that they are still the measure of a life lived toward God and neighbour.
